description:
Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption. 
Fading Echo is coming to PC on July 21, 2026, and later in 2026 to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Fading Echo - Official PC Launch Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at gameplay from Be My Horde in this latest trailer for the upcoming roguelite survivor where your minions fight for you. Become a formidable necromancer and turn your enemies into a resource! Raise fallen foes, build massive undead hordes, enhance your skills with devoured souls, and conquer the world – you’re the villain in this story. Be My Horde is in early access on PC. The Be My Horde: Rage Unleashed update is available now.
title: Be My Horde: Rage Unleashed - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this live-action trailer for Black Jacket, a narrative-driven roguelite deckbuilder where players gamble their souls against restless spirits in the afterlife. Black Jacket is available now on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch.

Trapped in the underworld, the player awakens among other lost souls. The only path to freedom runs through the Ferryman—a price keeper who demands payment in soul coins for passage back to life. To earn those coins, players must face off against the restless spirits who dwell in hell's card rooms, each one harboring their own tragic story, their own desperate bid for escape.
title: Black Jacket - Official Live-Action Trailer

description:

Hellcard II is scheduled to launch on PC (Steam) and consoles in Q3 2026
title: Hellcard 2 -  Official Blackmail Manor Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the official world premiere trailer for Dark Deity 3, the final chapter in the indie fan-favorite RPG series! Terrazael is running out of time as the God of Death approaches. Lead the charge in the final war featuring a unique dual-army narrative following Gwyn and Arthur Sildarian.

Experience the most ambitious Dark Deity story yet, packed with massive turn-based strategy depth: 28 playable units, 72 classes, over 100 weapons, 60+ build-defining rings, and a built-in randomizer for endless replayability. Watch fully voiced story sequences with custom in-game manga panels for major story beats!

Presented by Dark Deity 3.

#IGN #IGNLive #SummerOfGaming
title: Dark Deity 3 - Official World Premiere Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the official cinematic trailer for Enginefall. In the future, humanity’s final refuge amidst the post-apocalyptic wasteland is aboard colossal megatrains. Only some bold survivors have escaped to become Freerailers - nomads who roam the rails using their Dagger shuttle on a constant hunt to steal fuel and resources from the Titans they once called home. 

It’s up to you and your crew to take back what you’re owed. Board, scavenge, craft, build, and fight your way to First Class.

Enginefall’s open playtest runs from June 8th to the 14th, and will be available as a Steam Next Fest demo starting on June 15th.

Presented by Enginefall.

#IGN #IGNLive #SummerOfGaming
title: Enginefall - Official Cinematic Trailer

The Backstage DLC for Little Nightmares 3 arrives on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and Xbox on June 12 as part of the Secrets of The Spiral Expansion Pass.

WheelMates will be available on PC via Steam on September 7, 2026. An updated Steam Next Fest demo will be available on June 15, 2026.

Work together with a friend online or in split-screen co-op to drive RC cars and explore a house full of strange experiments. Use powerfully magnetic wheels, rope swings, and other gadgets to traverse tricky environments and solve puzzles in a kitchen, garage, backyard, and other domestic spaces turned into physics playgrounds.

Prison of Husks will be available on PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5 (PS5). A demo is out now.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Duskfade gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Duskfade trailer for this upcoming action-platformer game set in a clockpunk world full of magic and adventure. Duskfade will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC on August 13, 2026. A new demo is out now on Steam, and it is also available on PS5.

After the world has been plunged into an eternal night and his sister trapped in the mysterious Clock Tower at the heart of this mysterious darkness, Duskfade’s leading hero, Zirian, must explore the corrupted lands to uncover the ancient secrets of the Master Clockmakers, in hopes of finding a way to free her from the clutches of Despair. From ethereal forests and underwater realms, to the sunscorched dunes and lands above the clouds, there’s always a new vista begging to be explored.
title: Duskfade - Official Release Date and Switch 2 Announce Trailer

description:

Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements in The Alters. Help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.
title: The Alters: Last Variable - Official Release Date Trailer
